question.problem:
$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}x-y, & 0\le x\le 1,\,-1\le y\le 0, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}x+\frac{1}{2}, & 0\le x\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$  be continuous random variables. Their joint probability density function and the marginal probability density function of $X$ are shown above. Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=\frac{1}{2}]$ given that the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|\frac{1}{2}}=-\frac{7}{12}.$

current_example.problem:
$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}2y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x), & 1\le x\le e,\,0\le y\le 1, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(x), & 1\le x\le e, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$  be continuous random variables. Their joint probability density function and the marginal probability density function of $X$ are shown above. Find the conditional variance $\textrm{Var}\big[Y \,\big|\, X=1 \big]$ given that the corresponding expected value is $\mu_{Y|1}=\dfrac{2}{3}.$
current_example.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\textrm{E}\big[Y^2 \,| \, X=x \big] = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y^2 \, f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, x) \: \textrm{d}y.
$$

Note that $\textrm E\big[ Y \,|\, X = x \big]$ is a function of $x.$ 

The conditional density function of $Y$ given $X=x$ can be computed as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)} \\  & =\frac{2y\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(x)} \\  & =2y,\end{aligned}
$$

where $1 \leq x \leq e, \: 0 \leq y \leq 1.$ Outside this domain, we have $f_{Y|X} (y \,|\, x) = 0.$

Notice that $f_{Y|X} (y \,|\, x)$ does not depend on $x.$ Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}\cdot 2y\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}2{y}^{3}\text{d}y \\  & ={[\frac{{y}^{4}}{2}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1] & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1]-{\mu }_{Y|1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}-{(\frac{2}{3})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}-\frac{4}{9} \\  & =\frac{1}{18}.\end{aligned}
$$
